# InstaGold Buyers Refinery

> InstaGold is a licensed gold, precious metals, and luxury watch buyer and refinery located in the New York City Diamond District at 31 W 47th Street. We pay live spot-based prices for gold and precious metals and current market value for luxury watches, with free evaluations and same-day payment. We buy from sellers, we are not a retail store. Family owned on 47th Street since 1993.

## Business details

- Name: InstaGold (InstaGold Buyers Refinery)
- What we do: buy, sell, and refine gold, gold coins, bullion, silver, platinum, and diamonds; buy pre-owned luxury watches
- Address: 31 W 47th Street, Suite 202, New York, NY 10036
- Location: Diamond District, Midtown Manhattan, near Rockefeller Center, Bryant Park, and Grand Central Terminal
- Phone: (212) 901-5705
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm
- License: NYC DCWP License 2134780-DCWP
- Established: family owned on 47th Street since 1993
- Payment: same day, cash or wire, on accepted offers
- Cost to seller: free evaluation, no appointment needed, no obligation to sell
- Independent dealer, not affiliated with or endorsed by Rolex or any watch or jewelry manufacturer

## How valuation works

- Gold, silver, and platinum: priced by weight and purity against the live daily spot price
- Gold coins: valued at the higher of live metal price or numismatic collector value
- Luxury watches: valued on model and reference, condition and service history, originality of parts, and current collector demand, priced against real-time resale and auction data, not by metal weight
- Diamonds and jewelry: graded and valued in front of the seller

## Areas served

InstaGold serves sellers across Manhattan and the greater NYC metro, including Tribeca, Financial District, Chelsea, SoHo, Flatiron District, West Village, NoMad, Upper West Side, Upper East Side, Murray Hill, Gramercy, Hudson Yards, Lincoln Square, Midtown East, and nearby Brooklyn (DUMBO, Brooklyn Heights, Park Slope), Queens (Long Island City), and New Jersey (Hoboken, Downtown Jersey City). Neighborhood specific pages exist for gold, gold coins, Rolex, Audemars Piguet, and Cartier under each service path.

## Common questions

- Do you pay same day? Yes, by cash or wire once you accept an offer.
- Do I need an appointment? No, walk in during business hours or request an offer online first.
- Do you buy watches without box and papers? Yes, box and papers add value but are not required.
- Is there a fee to get an offer? No, evaluations are free with no obligation to sell.
- Where are you located? 31 W 47th Street, Suite 202, in the NYC Diamond District.
